labels: In a staged confrontation, one student's hand grips a fold of the other's jacket near the collar, with radiating fabric tension leading back to that single grip.; 연출된 대치에서 한 학생의 손이 상대 깃 근처 재킷 주름을 잡고 원단의 당김선이 그 한 접점으로 모인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: In a staged confrontation, one student's hand grips a fold of the other's jacket near the collar, with radiating fabric tension leading back to that single grip.
aliases: 멱살 잡기의 소유 관계
